name: Effigy fiscal data updater (PHP)
description: PHP module that fetches and caches European and Portuguese fiscal reference data: verified TLS, integrity-checked caches, and tested pipelines for upstream simulators.
longDescription: Modular fiscal updater that orchestrates HTTPS calls to official APIs, normalizes results, validates cache integrity, and feeds JSON cache and legacy tax files used by credit simulators. Fetch, transformation, and persistence are separated so failures are observable and retries do not corrupt prior good state. A CLI supports manual runs; automated tests cover core components. Docker Compose enables local verification without touching production hosts.
features: Orchestrated fiscal data fetch with TLS verification
JSON cache with integrity checks and backup handling
CLI tooling and automated test suites
Docker compose for repeatable local runs
Separation between cache, logs, and public module code
highlights: Test-backed pipeline from official APIs to simulator-facing data
Integrity checks reduce silent corruption risk in cached fiscal data
Containerized local smoke testing without production impact
challenges: Financial reference data must stay current and resilient to upstream API changes.
solutions: Central orchestrator, explicit cache validation, structured logging, and automated tests around fetch and transform logic.
security: HTTPS client with certificate verification enabled
Secrets supplied via environment templates only
Least-privilege layout for cache and logs
Upstream errors surfaced in logs rather than overwriting good cache blindly
